text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen. This time, Seiun Sky is drawing most of the crowd's attention, not to mention that of the other racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yet, despite the situation and knowing how skilled Grass Wonder and the other opponents are, Seiun Sky laughs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We enjoy thinking up strategies to conquer the other formidable runners. Seiun Sky heads off to the track, still mulling over some ideas.
